claims.text: Three speakers in the same corpus decline to corroborate. Asked directly by Michels on 28 May 2026 whether he had come across 'General William Neil McCaslin', former Army remote viewer Lyn Buchanan answered 'No', and to the follow-up naming Wright-Patterson, 'No, I didn't know that' (2:14:52). On 7 June 2026 Jeremy Corbell characterised the reported McCasland-to-Tom DeLonge contact as an operation, saying 'I said it's part of an op', while acknowledging that McCasland is missing (1:56:41 to 1:59:32). On 9 July 2026 Michael Shermer argued the disappearance against base rates, asking 'How many people go missing? It's thousands' and 'why aren't all the heads of all the nuclear sites or the generals... all going missing', while conceding it 'should be investigated. Obviously' by the family, local police or the FBI (1:14:21 to 1:20:51).
